aktion_fehler_laeuft_nicht: Only a running installation has this action.
aktion_fehler_nicht_angeboten: The app's manifest does not offer this action.
aktion_fehler_nicht_ausfuehrbar: The Zentrale cannot create the job.
aktion_fehler_sperrzeit: The app is in a freeze window; a restart has to wait until it ends.
aktion_neustart_text: Target: {name}. The agent restarts the app's units and waits until they run; never in a freeze window. The Zentrale creates a job and writes it to the audit log with the reason.
aktion_nur_lesen_text: Target: {name}. The agent runs the command “read only” from the app's manifest. The Zentrale creates a job and writes it to the audit log with the reason.
anm_code_text: The password is right. Now enter the six-digit code of the authenticator app.
anm_text: With a passkey, or with password and the code of the authenticator app.
apps_import_vorhanden: {app} {version} was imported already, with the same content.
apps_importieren_text: The signed manifest of one version: manifest.yml and manifest.yml.minisig. The Zentrale checks signature, schema and rules; from then on the version never changes and holds for every operator.
apps_registry_nie: Registry not asked yet; it is asked every 6 hours.
apps_registry_ohne_image: The manifest names no published image yet.
apps_text: The apps of the Speicherstadt. Each describes itself in a manifest; the Steuerzentrale knows only the manifest. What an app cannot do is listed as “not supported” with its issue.
apps_versionen_fehler: The versions cannot be read right now.
audit_text: Every write with actor, time, target and reason. Append-only; nobody can change or delete an entry.
auftraege_text: What the Zentrale asked the agents to do. A job names an action of the manifest, never a command; it is idempotent and continues after a lost connection or is reported as failed.
bak_schluessel: one repository and password per installation
bak_text: The parts come from the manifest (pg_dump, volume or command), per installation into a restic repository of its own on the operator's S3 target, daily as a timer on the server, also without the Zentrale.
bewertung_grund_keine_meldung: No report from the agent for 90 s
bewertung_grund_noch_keine_meldung: No report from the agent yet
bewertung_grund_nur_units: All units active; the manifest has no health check
einl_passwort_hinweis: Optional. Without a password the account signs in with a passkey only; with a password (at least 12 characters) an authenticator app is needed too.
einl_text: {betreiber} invites to the Steuerzentrale, with the role {rolle}.
einr_abgemeldet: Not signed in: the setup needs the session of an invitation, the setup code or a sign-in.
einr_fertig: The second factor is set up.
einr_passkey_mit_passwort: With a password a passkey alone is not enough: it can be added once the authenticator app is set up.
einr_passkey_text: Sign in with fingerprint, face or security key
einr_text: A passkey is enough. Signing in with a password also needs the code of an authenticator app (TOTP). Until then nothing else can be reached.
einr_totp_ersatz: Backup codes, each usable once if the authenticator app is missing. Keep them safe now; they are not shown again.
einr_totp_ohne_passwort: Not needed without a password: signing in uses the passkey.
einr_totp_qr: QR code for the authenticator app
einr_totp_text: Required for signing in with a password
einst_apps_felder_text: from the newest manifest of your installations (version {version}); a secret value is stored encrypted and never shown again
einst_apps_grund_platzhalter: e.g. new manufacturer ID from ELSTER
einst_apps_leer: No app with values of the operator installed yet.
einst_aufbewahrung_daten_wert: Heartbeats and log excerpts 30 days, events 13 months, audit log permanently
einst_backup_text: MinIO or S3 compatible; per installation an access of its own for its prefix only and a restic password; the admin's access stays in the Zentrale, never on a server
einst_dns_domain_hinweis: The addresses of the installations: <app>.<short name>.<domain>, e.g. apps.example.de
einst_dns_fehler_in_benutzung: Domain and zone stay while installations have DNS records there; only the token can change.
einst_dns_fehler_ungueltig: Please check the domain (lower case, with a dot), the zone ID (32 characters of 0–9 and a–f) and the token.
einst_dns_text: Cloudflare, DNS only, no proxy; the token stays in the Zentrale, never on a server
einst_dns_token_gesetzt: set; leave empty to keep the token
einst_dns_token_neu: Only with the permission Zone · DNS · Edit of this one zone; kept encrypted in the Zentrale, never on a server.
einst_dns_zone_hinweis: 32 characters of 0–9 and a–f, on the zone's overview in Cloudflare
einst_geheim_gesetzt: set; leave empty to keep it
einst_konten_text: Passkey or TOTP is required for every account
einst_melden_text: one message per fault, not per check
einst_rollen: Owner: everything · Technician: servers, installations, updates · Support: support access, log excerpt, restart
einst_signatur_wert: signed with minisign; the private key stays offline with the owner
einst_text: Operator values per app, backup target, DNS, notifications, accounts and the display.
einst_werte_text: the operator's values, for every installation of this app; a running one gets them with “Change settings” on its page
einst_zeitplan_wert: daily, staggered by up to 1 h per installation, as a systemd timer on the server; runs without the Zentrale too
einst_zertifikate_wert: HTTP-01 at the gateway, Let's Encrypt
ereig_text: Health, backups, updates, agents, checks and support access across all servers. Warnings and faults go out as set under Settings, one message per fault.
erst_text: The setup code is in the Zentrale's log at start. It is valid for 24 hours and once; with it the operator and its first owner are created.
fehler_abgeschlossen: The Zentrale is already set up.
fehler_code_ungueltig: The setup code is wrong or has expired.
fehler_einladung_ungueltig: This invitation is not or no longer valid.
fehler_email_vergeben: There is already an account for this email address.
fehler_falsch: Email address or password is wrong.
fehler_keine_berechtigung: Your role lacks the right for this.
fehler_ungueltig: Please check the details: the password needs at least 12 characters.
fehler_zu_viele: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
hinweis_agent: Agent {zustand}, last seen {seit}; its installations have no state
inst_aussen_text: DNS at Cloudflare, set by the Zentrale; checked independently of the agent
inst_bewertung_keine: from the agent, once it reports
inst_einrichtung_text: Jobs for the agent, with their state
inst_einstellungen_text: Values per installation, operator values for all installations, and automatic ones the Zentrale creates and never shows again
inst_entfernen_text: The agent removes what is left of the failed setup; it has no data.
inst_fehler_auftrag_offen: Another job of this installation is still open.
inst_fehler_einstellung_ungueltig: A value does not fit its setting.
inst_fehler_host_vergeben: Another installation already has this address.
inst_fehler_kein_manifest: There is no installation of this app yet, so no manifest to check the values against.
inst_fehler_kein_schluessel: The Zentrale lacks the public key for manifests (minisign.pub next to install.sh).
inst_fehler_keine_ports: No ports are left on the server.
inst_fehler_laeuft_nicht: Only a running installation can be reconfigured.
inst_fehler_nicht_einrichtbar: The app cannot be set up with these values.
inst_fehler_nicht_gescheitert: Only an installation whose setup failed can be removed here.
inst_fehler_nur_intern: A pre-release is only for installations of internal customers.
inst_fehler_passt_nicht: The app does not fit this server.
inst_fehler_signatur_ungueltig: The signature does not match the manifest or is not from the agents' key.
inst_fehler_sperrzeit: The app is in a freeze window; reconfiguring waits until it ends.
inst_fehler_ungueltig: Something is missing or not in the right form, the address for instance.
inst_fehler_version_vergeben: This version is imported already with other content; an imported version never changes.
inst_gekuendigt_text: Deletion on {datum}, after a final backup. Until the contract ends the app runs normally; read-only and export as far as its manifest offers them.
inst_gescheitert_text: The agent cleaned up, nothing is left on the server. Removing frees address and ports; then the app can be installed again.
inst_keine_werte: No values; the manifest's defaults apply.
inst_konfigurieren_felder_text: from the manifest; an empty secret field keeps its value, an empty text field takes the default
inst_konfigurieren_grund_platzhalter: e.g. the customer asked by mail
inst_konfigurieren_text: The Zentrale sends the job “Reconfigure” with these values and the operator's current ones; the agent writes units and secrets anew and restarts the app. The values apply once it reports success; if it fails, the old state stays.
inst_support_text: Access to this installation only with a support access: time-limited (2 hours by default), with a reason, in the audit log and the customer's events. It allows a log excerpt and a restart.
inst_text: Each app of a customer runs under its own Linux user with its own Podman Quadlets, network and volumes.
inst_verlauf_text: Every change of state with its reason, kept 90 days
inst_werte_text: The Zentrale never shows secret values.
installieren_betreiber_text: the placement misses them; they are stored with the installation and apply to every installation of this app
installieren_einstellungen_text: from the manifest; the Zentrale sets the operator's values and the automatic ones
installieren_host_hinweis: Host name of the app; the gateway fetches the certificate. Without a domain in the DNS settings the Zentrale sets no DNS record.
installieren_host_hinweis_domain: Host name of the app; the gateway fetches the certificate. Below {domain} the Zentrale sets A and AAAA; the operator sets any other address himself.
installieren_manifest_hinweis: The signed manifest of the app and version.
installieren_platzierung_offen: Choose customer, server, app and version, then the Zentrale checks whether the app fits.
installieren_platzierung_text: From manifest and server facts: architecture, RAM, disk, ports, public IP, server of its own, dependencies, required values.
installieren_signatur_hinweis: The Zentrale checks it with the key the agents have too.
installieren_text: The agent creates a Linux user of its own, writes the Quadlet units from the signed manifest, pulls the images, runs the setup steps and starts the app.
installieren_version_hinweis: From the imported, signed manifests; a pre-release only for internal customers.
kunde_aendern_text: The details replace the current ones; what changes stands in the audit log with the reason.
kunde_anlegen_text: For customers who do not come through the portal. They never sign in to the Steuerzentrale; their contract starts with SLA Basis.
kunde_extern_text: Its installations then go into the wave “alle”; pre-releases are no longer offered to them.
kunde_gekuendigt_text: Until then everything runs normally. Afterwards read-only and export as far as the apps can, otherwise the last backup for the customer; deletion on {datum}, after a backup. Nothing is deleted before the deadline.
kunde_intern_text: An internal customer is ourselves: its installations form the wave “intern” and alone are offered pre-releases.
kunde_kuendigen_text: Until the contract ends everything runs as usual. Then 30 days read only and export where the apps can, else the customer gets the last backup; deletion follows 90 days after the end, with a backup first.
kunde_kuerzel_fest: Fixed while an installation of the customer runs or is being set up.
kunde_kuerzel_hinweis: Part of the addresses <app>.<short name>.<domain>: lower-case letters, digits, hyphens. Existing addresses stay.
kunde_kuerzel_hinweis_neu: Part of the addresses <app>.<short name>.<domain>: lower-case letters, digits, hyphens; leave empty to get one from the name.
kunde_verlauf_text: the customer sees these in the portal too
kunde_zuruecknehmen_text: The contract runs on as before; the deletion on {datum} is dropped.
kunden_fehler_ende_vor_beginn: The contract end lies before its start.
kunden_fehler_kuerzel_fest: The short name is fixed while an installation of the customer runs or is being set up.
kunden_fehler_kuerzel_vergeben: Another customer already has this short name.
kunden_text: Customers, their contract and their installations. Customers never sign in here; they see their state in the portal.
leist_text: What each customer used in a month: installations, availability, data and support time. The portal writes the invoices.
leistungen_spaeter: Installations, storage and support time per customer and month come with this item; until then the Zentrale shows nothing here.
log_auszug_gescheitert: The agent could not read the journal: {fehler}
log_auszug_grund_platzhalter: e.g. request from the portal: slow sign-in
log_auszug_still: The agent has not answered yet. The job stays open; request the excerpt again later.
log_auszug_text: {name}: the last 500 lines from journald ({nutzer}). The agent replaces the values of the secrets before it sends them; the Zentrale keeps them for 30 days.
log_auszug_wartet: The agent is reading the journal …
nicht_gefunden_text: This page does not exist, or the object was removed.
platz_agent_getrennt: The server's agent is not connected.
platz_architektur_container: The container {container} is not available for {server}.
platz_architektur_option: The option {option} is not available for {server}.
platz_betreiberwert_fehlt: The operator's required value {name} is missing (Settings).
platz_braucht_dienst: The app needs {dienst}; no installation of the customer offers it.
platz_braucht_server_fuer_sich: The app needs a server of its own; {andere} installations run here already.
platz_fakten_fehlen: The agent has not reported all facts yet: {fakten}.
platz_installation_unlesbar: The manifest of the installation {installation} cannot be read.
platz_kein_image: The container {container} has no image yet.
platz_kein_ptr: For mail, the public IPv4 lacks its PTR record.
platz_keine_oeffentliche_ipv4: The app needs a public IPv4; the server has none.
platz_platte: Not enough disk space: {bedarf} MB needed, {verfuegbar} MB available.
platz_platte_knapp: Disk space gets tight: {prozent} % planned afterwards.
platz_port25_gesperrt: For mail, outgoing port 25 is blocked or unknown.
platz_port_belegt: Port {port}/{proto} is already in use on the server.
platz_ram: Not enough memory: {bedarf} MB needed, {verfuegbar} MB available.
platz_server_anderer_betreiber: The server belongs to another operator.
platz_server_anderer_kunde: The server belongs to another customer.
platz_server_belegt_fuer_sich: An app that needs the server for itself runs on it.
pruefung_neustart_geplant: needed for the new kernel; scheduled in the maintenance window at {zeit}
server_ausstehend_text: unattended-upgrades installed these last night; the new kernel takes effect only after the reboot.
server_befehl_einmal: The command shows only now: the Zentrale keeps only the token's hash.
server_befehl_text: {name}: as root on Debian 13 or Ubuntu 24.04 (amd64, arm64). The token is valid once and for 24 hours.
server_befehl_titel: Run the command on the server
server_hinzufuegen_text: The Zentrale then shows a command with a one-time token. It sets up Podman, unattended-upgrades and the agent; the agent connects on its own.
server_installationen_text: Installations: {n}, customers: {kunden}; each under its own Linux user
server_keine_fakten_text: The agent has not reported any facts yet.
server_neustart_regel: A reboot runs only in the maintenance window and never in a freeze window of an app on this server.
server_ram_vergeben: Assigned by manifests: {vergeben} of {gesamt} GB RAM
server_schritt_pakete: Installs Podman (4.9 or later), minisign, unattended-upgrades and the agent (checksum, signature) as a systemd service
server_schritt_ports: Allows rootless ports from 80 for the Pforte
server_schritt_schluessel: Stores the public key for manifests and fetches the client certificate
server_schritt_system: Checks system, architecture, cgroup v2 and clock
server_text: Shared servers, dedicated servers and servers at the customer. Each runs the agent; it connects out by itself and reports every 30 seconds. unattended-upgrades installs security updates; the Zentrale schedules reboots in the server's maintenance window.
server_wartung_hinweis: Daily, Berlin time; reboots only here and never in a freeze window of the apps on the server.
sla_basis_text: Updates with everyone else, after the internal wave
sla_plus_text: Updates early, right after the internal wave
sperrzeiten_aktiv: Active now: {apps}; no updates and reboots.
sup_text: Access to an installation only for a limited time (2 hours by default), with a reason. An access allows a log excerpt and a restart, ends by itself and is in the audit log and the customer's events.
support_spaeter: Time-limited support access with a reason comes with this item; until then the Zentrale shows nothing here.
uebersicht_alles_gut: Nothing to do: no fault, no warning, no failed job.
uebersicht_aufmerksamkeit_text: Faults and warnings: {n}, the worst first
uebersicht_text: What needs attention comes first; every entry leads to its cause.
upd_agent_fenster: checksum and signature, in the maintenance window at {zeit}
upd_agent_regel: The Zentrale understands agents one version back.
upd_angebote_text: per installation from the imported manifests; a pre-release only for internal customers
upd_plan_text: signed manifest since {seit} · before {vorher} · cancelled installations stay out
upd_regel: “all” starts 24 h after “internal” ends, if no fault came, and never in a freeze window.
upd_registry_text: a new tag without a signed manifest; no wave until it is imported
upd_schritt_image: Pull the image by digest, set it in the Quadlet unit
upd_schritt_nach_update: Commands after the update from the manifest
upd_schritt_neustart: Restart the units, wait for health
upd_schritt_zurueck: Health red: old version and backup back, stop the wave, report
upd_sperrzeit_aktiv: One is active today: no update for this app, no reboot on its servers.
upd_text: New versions with a signed manifest, rolled out in waves: first “internal”, then “all” once “internal” ran 24 hours without a fault. Never in a freeze window, and a backup runs before each installation.
upd_von_hand_text: No wave updates apps without health; only a person with a reason
welle_alle_text: everyone else, 24 h after “internal” without a fault
bak_lauf_regel: A failed run is an event
bak_zugang_einrichten: being set up on the server
inst_backup_teile: Parts from the manifest: {teile} · one restic repository per installation on the operator's S3 target
inst_backup_ohne_teile: The app's manifest names nothing to back up.
aktion_backup_text: Target: {name}. The agent backs up the manifest's parts right now into the installation's restic repository. The Zentrale makes a job and writes it with its reason to the audit log.
aktion_backup_angefordert: Backup requested; the run shows under “Backups” once the agent reports it.
aktion_fehler_nicht_eingerichtet: The backups of this installation are not set up yet.
aktion_fehler_backup_laeuft: A backup of this installation is already running.
einst_backup_endpunkt_hinweis: https://… of the MinIO, without a path
einst_backup_region_hinweis: as set in the MinIO, else us-east-1
einst_backup_bucket_hinweis: Per installation the prefix <operator>/<installation>/, which only its access reaches
einst_backup_zugang_gesetzt: set; leave both empty to keep the access
einst_backup_zugang_neu: An access allowed to make service accounts; stays encrypted in the Zentrale, never on a server.
einst_backup_grund_platzhalter: e.g. MinIO set up at the operator
einst_backup_fehler_ungueltig: Please check endpoint (https, no path), region, bucket and both keys of the access.
einst_backup_fehler_in_benutzung: Endpoint and bucket stay while installations have an access there; region and access can change.
einst_backup_fehler_zugang_fehlt: The first time, the Zentrale needs the admin's access.
hinweis_pruef_alt: No test restore for over 8 days; last {seit}
bak_pruef_regel: weekly per installation as a copy on its own server, removed afterwards
einst_pruef_wert: weekly per installation as a copy with its own ports on its own server, when there is room; removed afterwards
aktion_pruef_text: Target: {name}. The agent sets up a copy with its own ports on the installation's server, restores the newest snapshot of each part, checks its health and removes it again; the installation keeps running unchanged. The Zentrale makes a job and writes it with its reason into the audit log.
aktion_pruef_grund_platzhalter: e.g. after changing the S3 target
aktion_pruef_angefordert: Test restore requested; the result shows under “Backups” once the agent reports it.
aktion_fehler_kein_backup: There is no successful backup yet that could be restored.
aktion_fehler_server_belegt: Another test restore is running on the server.
aktion_fehler_kein_platz: The server has no room for a copy of the installation.
aktion_fehler_keine_ports: The server has no free port for the copy.
wh_text: Target: {name}, state of {zeit}. The agent plays back this run's snapshots; the app cannot be reached meanwhile. The Zentrale makes the jobs and writes them to the audit log with the reason.
wh_hinweis_titel: The current state is backed up first
wh_hinweis: Only once this backup succeeds does the agent play back the chosen run; if it fails, everything stays as it is. So even a run chosen by mistake can be undone.
wh_grund_platzhalter: e.g. the customer's request of 20 Nov
wh_angefordert: Restore requested; the current state is backed up first.
wh_sichern: running: backing up the current state, then the state of {stand}
wh_zurueckspielen: running: playing back the state of {stand}
aktion_fehler_lauf_unbekannt: The Zentrale does not know this run for this installation.
aktion_fehler_lauf_gescheitert: A failed run cannot be restored.
upd_dialog_text: Target: {name}, now {version}. The agent pulls the new version by digest, runs the steps after the update and waits for green health. The Zentrale makes the jobs and writes them with the reason to the audit log.
upd_hinweis_titel: The current state is backed up first
upd_hinweis: The update starts only once this backup succeeds; if it fails, everything stays as it is. If the new version does not turn healthy, the agent rolls it back and plays this backup back.
upd_grund_platzhalter: e.g. security update as advised by the vendor
upd_sperrzeit_regel: In a freeze window of the app only the owner updates; the update then counts as the release.
upd_angefordert: Update requested; the current state is backed up first.
upd_plan_freigabe_noetig: {version}: waits for a release by hand
upd_fehler_sperrzeit: The app is in a freeze window; only the owner can update now.
upd_fehler_server_belegt: Another update is running on the server.
upd_fehler_nicht_angeboten: This version is not offered to the installation.
upd_fehler_kein_manifest: No manifest is imported for this version.
upd_fehler_werte_fehlen: The new version lacks a required value of the installation; complete the settings first.
